name: Lactitol
aliases: E966, lactitol, lactitol monohydrate, lactit, lactobiosit, lactositol, lactitol monohidrato
what_is: A polyol produced from lactose and used mainly as a bulk sweetener and texturising ingredient.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because E966 is a sugar-replacing sweetener that can also contribute bulk and texture, with permitted uses set by jurisdiction.
can_1: Identify E966 or lactitol when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number, sweetener and texture information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the amount present unless the manufacturer provides it.
cannot_2: Predict individual tolerance or infer the product's overall nutritional effect from the presence of lactitol alone.

sources.label: FDA — Aspartame and Other Sweeteners in Food
EU specifications for authorised food additives — Regulation (EU) No 231/2012
